learning_outcomes.text: Students to learn how to collect and systematize knowledge and skills learned in all prior studies and present these in developing the thesis of the field of electric power and electric equipment and its public defence.

syllabus_topics: Compilation of the work program and schedule of the thesis preparing
Data acquisition, literature sources researching and analyzing known solutions
Determining the theoretical topics concerning to the thesis
Choice of suitable project and research methods
Formulation of the purposes and tasks of thesis
assessment_rules: The Self Preparing for thesis successfully ends after performance of all tasks in the work program and the supervisor’s approval of the student’s report. The Self Preparing for thesis is not assessed and its efficiency will be evidenced on the public defence of the thesis.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Electrical Power Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS FEEA (datos antiguos; ver notas)
